$note: One shot per scene in script.md, keyed by scene id (DL-169). Claude keeps these in step with the script's Shot: notes. Look: style/reference-analysis.md. kind 'desk' films a fixture state's window (ground 'paper' by default, 'wallpaper' for the desktop); 'drawn' is a drawn scene; 'card' is a title card. A move or callout targets an anchor (label or identifier) or a rect in window points, and lands on a word of line N. Script v1's shots are in archive/shots-v1.json. Each shot carries shotSha (the hash of its Shot: note and the prose after it) and requires: one item per thing the note asks for, built true or false. The build stops when a note changes and reports every unbuilt item.
